# Echo by onetest

> Echo records the Teams calls you choose, transcribes them on your computer, and — through Claude Code on your own account — writes minutes, keeps a work board per client and answers questions across calls, chats, mail and files. A menu bar / tray app for macOS and Windows with its own window, the `echoctl` command line and a Claude Code plugin. Plugins extend it with their own code.

## Extending Echo

- [Extend Echo (Markdown)](https://echo.onetest.ai/extend/index.md): the plugin documentation — what a plugin is, a quick start, the manifest (`uses` and its install-sheet lines, `widgets`, `dashboards`, `routines`, `skills`, `agent`, `icon`; `uses.me`, `uses.skills`), the host API (`ctx` in main.js: commands, timers and events, its store and settings (`ctx.store.copyIn`, `usage`, settings defaults, the `__testSettings` connection test), values per thread, per client and shared ones, About me (`ctx.me`), the Inbox and delivery, Markdown pages with wikilinks, Microsoft 365 reads, speech to text (`uses.speech`, `ctx.speech.transcribe`), sign-ins, scripts, wrapper profiles), Claude Code (`ctx.claude.run`, runs under a key and `ctx.claude.stop`, pictures, streamed text and conversations (`images`, `onText`, `resume`, `ctx.claude.forget`), runs in a folder the user gave it, `ctx.claude.session`, skills in the user's own Claude Code with `ctx.claude.installSkill`, and how permissions follow the user's settings), routines of its own and Echo's background jobs, folders and files (`ctx.fs`, snapshots, the hidden files it may write, file handles, their text with `ctx.files.text`, git, Show in Finder with `ctx.system.reveal`), the network (named hosts, addresses the user lists, streams, WebSockets, trusted certificates, a typed address, reading a web page as Markdown with `ctx.web`, any public https page with `uses.network.web`, pages that build themselves with scripts via `render: true`, the window's own Web APIs), Echo's data (`ctx.echo.read` kinds incl. `people` (with places and reporting lines), `threads` (with their AI profile) and `recording`, call stamps, thread stage and task writes), Claude in Echo (`agent/`, skills, sessions), every place a plugin shows up in the window (slots incl. `call.row`, `call.header`, `call.minutes`, `thread.profile` and `client.profile`, sheets, panels, Settings pages, ⌘K actions, activities with graphs, Inbox items, the microphone) with what each receives, Today widgets (the eight kinds, charts, tables, `ctx.widgets.provide/set/clear/changed`, settings, links and actions, a page of its own), dashboards a plugin offers, work rows, marketplaces, checking and testing (incl. a fake Microsoft 365), the security model and the command line (incl. `echoctl intake`). Members marked "0.10.0", "0.10.1" or "0.10.3" need that Echo or later.
- [echo-plugin.d.ts](https://echo.onetest.ai/extend/echo-plugin.d.ts): TypeScript types for the manifest (`Uses`, `WidgetDef`, `DashboardDef`, `RoutineDef`), every `ctx` service of `HostContext` and `ClientContext`, event payloads, the slot targets (`calendar.event`, `call.menu`, `task.actions`, `thread.profile`, `client.profile`, `call.row`, `call.header`, `call.minutes`), file handles, Claude Code runs, work rows and widget data by kind.
- [Echo's own plugins](https://github.com/onetest-ai/echo-plugins): Scheduler, Telegram and Obsidian — working examples, and the built-in marketplace.

## Echo

- [Home](https://echo.onetest.ai/): what Echo does, from call to answer.
- [Install](https://echo.onetest.ai/install/): macOS and Windows, Claude Code and its Echo plugin, Microsoft 365 — a check after each step, and troubleshooting.
- [Source](https://github.com/onetest-ai/echo): the app (Rust), its window and the Claude Code plugin.
- [Releases](https://github.com/onetest-ai/echo/releases/latest): macOS (signed, notarized) and Windows builds.

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://echo.onetest.ai/privacy/): no Echo servers, no telemetry; call text goes only to the AI the user chooses.
- [Windows builds](https://echo.onetest.ai/windows/): how they are built and checked; not code-signed yet.
